title: #84 Failure to Success
prompt: What is your view on the idea that it takes failure to achieve success?

promptSegments.text: What is your view on the idea that it takes failure to achieve success?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Mistakes help people learn new things.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Bad times build character.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Success is achieved through careful planning and hard work, as demonstrated by a student who studies diligently to achieve good grades.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Success is achieved through careful planning and hard work, as demonstrated by a student who studies diligently to achieve good grades.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: People can improve their skills over time through consistent practice, exemplified by a cook mastering recipes.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: People can improve their skills over time through consistent practice, exemplified by a cook mastering recipes.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Failure provides crucial learning opportunities that help individuals improve their skills and knowledge.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Failure provides crucial learning opportunities that help individuals improve their skills and knowledge.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Dealing with setbacks builds mental toughness and resilience, which are necessary traits for achieving long-term goals.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Dealing with setbacks builds mental toughness and resilience, which are necessary traits for achieving long-term goals.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Success is achieved through planning and effort, not necessarily through failure.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Success is achieved through planning and effort, not necessarily through failure.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Smart strategies and good management are sufficient for success, making failure unnecessary.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Smart strategies and good management are sufficient for success, making failure unnecessary.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.

faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the role of failure in achieving success through structured arguments and evidence-based reasoning.
keyArguments: Failure is an essential part of the learning process as it provides opportunities for growth and improvement.
Overcoming setbacks through persistence and self-reflection leads to personal development and eventual success.
